name: Inostropia
description: Dive into a complex 6-year-old history of factions, politics, and wars, mainly shaped by players like you! On the Inostropia SMP server, you can create villages and cities, expand your influence, and rise to power through diplomacy, business, or brutal warfare. Build a thriving economy, grow your wealth, and decide whether to share your success with allies or keep it all for yourself (depending on how evil you are). Who knows, maybe you’ll become the one controlling the quartz brick monopoly.
